span.p:
Conflict Resolution
Last-Writer-Wins (LWW)
or CRDT merge

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Challenge: Two regions writing to the same key simultaneously.
Without global locking, conflicts are inevitable.
Solutions: Last-writer-wins (simple, may lose data)
CRDTs (complex, preserves all updates)
Global write coordinator (adds cross-region latency)
